note: Conceptual lesson teaching STRIDE (a general, vendor-neutral threat-modeling framework originally from Microsoft) applied to two Salesforce-specific scenarios (an inbound integration, a public donation form). No screenshots, per this course's conceptual/architecture policy -- taught through a STRIDE term table and two worked/lab scenarios. STRIDE's six categories are a well-established industry framework, not a Salesforce product claim, so the only verification needed was confirming the standard category definitions.
